name: Desert Dog Offroad Adventures
tagline: Your Story with Panicci Ventures — Video Testimonial
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each — and yes, the numbers in these questions are your real numbers.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, your role at Desert Dog Offroad Adventures, and what you do out in the Arizona desert.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before Panicci Ventures, how were people finding your tours — and what wasn't working about it?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: There's no shortage of marketing agencies pitching tour operators. Why Sammy — and why has it stuck?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: Walk us through what Panicci Ventures handles for you — the website, search, Google Business Profile, reviews, reporting.

questions.label: The Numbers
questions.text: Real numbers: your site was seen on Google over 880,000 times in the last 12 months — three and a half times the year before — and clicks are up 76%. Did you realize it was that much?

questions.label: Rankings
questions.text: You're #1 on Google for “Scottsdale off road,” #2 for “dune buggies Phoenix,” and top-10 for a whole list of tour searches. What do bookings look like when rankings move like that?

questions.label: Reviews
questions.text: 1,084 Google reviews, a 4.9 average, and every single one gets a reply. What does that kind of reputation do for a tour business?

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's working best right now — and which result honestly surprised you the most?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from other agencies you've tried — communication, speed, month-to-month with no lock-in?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another tour or adventure operator who's pouring money into ads but can't be found on Google?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures, spoken by the owner of Desert Dog Offroad Adventures (azadventures.com). Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. The NUMBERS, RANKINGS, and REVIEWS answers are the hero clips (real stats + reaction); RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
